newsitem.title: USA: Coachmen agrees to buy New England Homes.
newsitem.headline: Coachmen agrees to buy New England Homes.

text.p: Coachmen Industries Inc said Monday it agreed in principle to buy New England Homes.
It said owner Daniel Donahue will continue as president of New England Homes, which is a Greenland, N.H.-based builder of modular homes. Terms were not disclosed.
New England Homes will remain a separate entity under the Coachmen Housing Group, which also includes the All American housing operations in Indiana, Iowa, North Carolina and Tennessee.
The purchase fits Coachmen's strategy of expanding its modular housing manufacturing interests.
